ecosystem_scan_results.headline: OpenAI Officially Launches ChatGPT Search, Integrating Real-Time Web Retrieval into Frontier Model
ecosystem_scan_results.summary: OpenAI rolled out native web search inside ChatGPT powered by fine-tuned GPT-4o with synthetic distillation from OpenAI o1. Includes interactive weather, stocks, maps, news carousels, and licensed publisher partnerships.
ecosystem_scan_results.technical_delta: Transitioned from static text training cutoff to live real-time web grounding with automated search intent classification and inline attribution sidebar.

ecosystem_scan_results.vector_name: Open-Source AI & Edge Small Language Models
ecosystem_scan_results.headline: Hugging Face Releases SmolLM2: 135M, 360M, and 1.7B Parameter Models for Local On-Device AI
ecosystem_scan_results.summary: Hugging Face published the SmolLM2 family trained on 11 trillion tokens of curated synthetic and educational datasets (FineWeb-Edu, Cosmopedia v2), outperforming Llama 3.2 1B on edge hardware under Apache 2.0.
ecosystem_scan_results.technical_delta: Proves that extreme dataset filtration allows sub-2B models to handle instruction following and reasoning locally on mobile devices without cloud inference.

ecosystem_scan_results.headline: Physical Intelligence Unveils pi-0: A 50 Hz Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for Generalist Robotics
ecosystem_scan_results.source_tier: Tier 1 - Primary arXiv Research Paper & Demonstration Portal
ecosystem_scan_results.summary: PaliGemma VLM coupled to continuous Flow Matching action expert operating at 50 Hz across 7 robot platforms, folding deformable laundry and assembling boxes.
ecosystem_scan_results.technical_delta: Replaces 3 Hz discrete action tokenization with continuous ODE flow matching, enabling 10x higher motor control frequency.

ecosystem_scan_results.headline: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet Computer Use API Enters Global Enterprise Deployment
ecosystem_scan_results.summary: Anthropic's computer use public beta enables frontier models to observe screens, move mouse cursors, click buttons, and type text to complete multi-step software tasks.
ecosystem_scan_results.technical_delta: Major milestone, but primary release occurred 10 days prior; current coverage represents ongoing deployment rather than rolling 24-hour breaking release.

ecosystem_scan_results.headline: Google DeepMind Accelerates Gemini 1.5 Flash-8B Production Deployments
ecosystem_scan_results.summary: Google's 8-billion parameter multimodal model reaches high throughput for high-frequency low-latency developer tasks at sub-cent pricing.
ecosystem_scan_results.technical_delta: Steady-state commercial deployment; not a rolling 24-hour architectural breakthrough.
